description: A composite figure mixing SEM fracture-surface micrographs with dimple-size statistics, organised in three columns headed AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T (three multiphase low-density steels). (a) "Microcrack initiation and propagation" is a 3×2 array of SEM images: the upper row carries 10 µm scale bars with yellow dashed circles marking microscale voids at soft/hard domain interfaces; the lower row carries 5 µm scale bars, where yellow arrows in AN750-T and AN800-T mark a blunted crack tip with secondary cracks and a red arrow in AN850-T marks a severed hard domain. (b) "Morphology of central fracture zone" shows three SEM images with 10 µm scale bars, annotated "Dimple" (yellow arrows) in AN750-T and both "Dimple" and "Quasi-cleavage" (red dashed ellipse) in AN800-T and AN850-T. (c) "Statistics of dimple size" stacks three histograms of Fraction (0–0.4) versus Size of dimple (µm, 0–4): grey AN750-T (Ave = 1.54, Peak I: 0.72, Peak II: 2.26), red AN800-T (Ave = 1.44, Peak I: 0.59, Peak II: 2.14) and blue AN850-T (Ave = 1.31, Peak I: 0.60, Peak II: 1.78), each bimodal. A top-right schematic of a dog-bone tensile specimen with red dots marks the sampled necking region.

subfigures.description: 3 columns (AN750-T, AN800-T, AN850-T) × 2 rows of SEM images of crack paths. Upper row 10 µm scale bars with yellow dashed circles around microscale voids/interface voids; lower row 5 µm scale bars with yellow arrows pointing to secondary cracks in AN750-T and AN800-T and a red arrow pointing to a severed hard domain in AN850-T.

Three SEM images of the central fracture zone with 10 µm scale bars. AN750-T shows deep dimples (yellow arrow, 'Dimple' label). AN800-T and AN850-T show 'Dimple' (yellow arrows) plus a red dashed ellipse labelled 'Quasi-cleavage'.

Three stacked histograms of Fraction (y, 0–0.4) versus Size of dimple (µm) (x, 0–4), coloured grey (AN750-T), red (AN800-T) and blue (AN850-T), each with Peak I / Peak II markers and printed Ave, Peak I and Peak II values, showing a bimodal dimple-size distribution.

Schematic of a flat dog-bone tensile specimen with red dots indicating the necking region sampled for SEM; digital-correlation-like shaded bands overlay the gauge section. Labels unreadable at supplied resolution.

observations.observation: The figure is organised in three sample columns labelled AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T.
Panel (a) top row micrographs carry 10 µm scale bars; the bottom row carries 5 µm scale bars.
Yellow dashed circles in the top row of (a) mark microscale voids, positioned at interfaces between domains.
In (a), yellow arrows mark blunted crack tips with secondary cracks in AN750-T and AN800-T, whereas a red arrow marks a severed hard domain in AN850-T.
In (b), AN750-T shows deep dimples; AN800-T and AN850-T show dimples together with a red dashed ellipse labelled 'Quasi-cleavage'.
The (c) histograms plot Fraction (0–0.4, ticks at 0.2 and 0.4) against Size of dimple in µm (0–4, ticks at 1, 2, 3, 4).
Printed values for AN750-T in (c): Ave = 1.54, Peak I: 0.72, Peak II: 2.26.
Printed values for AN800-T in (c): Ave = 1.44, Peak I: 0.59, Peak II: 2.14.
Printed values for AN850-T in (c): Ave = 1.31, Peak I: 0.60, Peak II: 1.78.
All three histograms in (c) are bimodal, with a small-population Peak I below about 1 µm and a larger-population Peak II near 2 µm.
A small schematic of a tensile specimen with red dots marking the necking region (the sampled location) appears at the top right of the figure.
The caption states that crack path and dimple statistics of multiphase steels were characterised by SEM.
The citing text states the necking region after tensile fracture (red dot in Fig. 11) was selected for SEM analysis.
The citing text states microscale voids (yellow dashed boxes) are mainly distributed at the interface of the soft domain and hard domain.
The citing text states dimple size distribution was analysed with Nano Measure software and shows bimodal distributions, AN750-T having the larger average dimple sizes.
